name: Sound FX
effect: ON: sound effects play (shots, steps, doors). OFF: no sound effect starts, but speech and music still play.

name: Music
effect: ON: the music plays, and turning it ON starts the theme at once. OFF: the music stops.

name: Fast Scroll
effect: ON: the map view scrolls on every arrow key at once. OFF: after one scroll step the next waits 70 ms.

name: Alt Scroll
effect: ON: a waiting scroll step runs only while Alt is held. OFF: it runs when Alt is up and the 200 ms hover time is over. The mouse-edge scroll uses the same rule.

name: Shadows
effect: ON: the map draws shadows under soldiers and objects. OFF: no shadows.

name: Subtitles
effect: ON: speech shows as text, and step noises show as words such as "clunk". OFF: a face slides in for speech and the texts stay away.

name: Item Info
effect: ON: a right click on an item shows the item info box. OFF: you only hear the item name, except for picture items such as letters.

name: Show Paths
effect: ON: the walk cursor marks the path tiles on the map. OFF: no path marks show.

name: Pal Cycling
effect: ON: water colours cycle and random ambient sounds play. OFF: the colours stay still and no ambient sound plays.

name: Fast Anims
effect: ON: walking animations run at half the frame delay, so mercs move faster on screen. OFF: normal delay.

name: Follow move
effect: ON: in a fight the view follows your selected merc while it moves. OFF: the view follows only the enemies you see.

name: Step Sounds
effect: ON: you hear footstep sounds of soldiers you can see. OFF: no footstep sounds.

name: Day Replays
effect: ON: after sunset the game replays the day on the island map. OFF: no replay.

name: Fast Firing
effect: ON: a left click with the weapon cursor fires at once, also in a fight. OFF: in a fight the first click starts the aim.

name: Safety Move
effect: ON: a walk needs a second left click on the same tile. OFF: one click starts the walk.

name: Merc OKs
effect: ON: a merc answers with a spoken "OK" when you give a move order with a marker. OFF: no answer.

name: Allow save (ALLOWSAVE)
effect: Program option. ON: a loaded game from before v1.14 with no quick-save mode set gets quick save in a fight. The original prints a notice and waits for a key; the port prints it to stderr.
